Delivery chain

Current-head review pair + issue-specific API/UI and GitHub gates → Serialized rebase auto-merges → Combined RC + pinned digest/revision → RC deployment → Direct API + UI behavior proof → Release → AKS deployment

Each milestone PR needs a final local rubber-duck and code-review pair on its current head before readiness. After issue-specific API/UI and GitHub gates pass, authorize gh pr merge --rebase --auto one PR at a time; monitor until merged before admitting the next.

Platform integrity checks establish setup only; they do not pass the live behavior gate.
